theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_sos_cfs_cone_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1)), R.Represents X → R.carrier ⊆ X.support → R.measure univ ≠ ∞ → X.boundary = 0 → IsCompact X.support → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1), Y.boundary = X ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ {y : Euclid P | ∃ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ x ∈ X.support, y = s • x} ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1 + 1), ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (q + 1), (∀ x ∈ X.support, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1)) x = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ (q + 1) • ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (q + 1 + 1)) (t • x)).curryLeft x) ∧ Y ω = X η
